hints.title: Frequency-Based Generation
hints.text: Because tiles contain duplicate letters, count frequencies of each unique character. Sequences can be formed by picking any available letter with remaining frequency.

hints.title: Recursive Branching
hints.text: At each recursive level, iterate through distinct letters with positive counts. Each selection forms a distinct non-empty prefix.

hints.title: Backtracking State Management
hints.text: When choosing letter c, increment total sequence count by 1, decrement its frequency, recurse, and restore its frequency upon return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations without grouping duplicates creates redundant sequences and wastes time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Backtracking over frequency histograms naturally skips duplicate sequences with minimal stack memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should count character frequencies to avoid duplicate permutation exploration.
complexity.notes: Since N <= 7, search space is at most 13,700 states.
